column2: A villain knight in dull iron plate armour with a crimson-red tunic and tall red helmet plume, holding a thick horizontal red-and-white spiral-striped jousting lance pointed straight right, riding astride a large scruffy brown buzzard vulture with hooked yellow beak and two strong yellow taloned legs

A villain knight in bright silver-steel plate armour with gold trim and a pointed visor helmet with yellow crest, no cape, holding a thick horizontal silver-and-gold striped jousting lance pointed straight right, riding astride a large slate-grey buzzard vulture with hooked beak and two strong taloned legs

A menacing elite knight in obsidian-black and royal-purple plate armour with a glowing violet visor slit and purple helmet crest, no cape, holding a thick horizontal purple-and-silver striped jousting lance pointed straight right, riding astride a large black-and-violet buzzard vulture with hooked beak and two strong taloned legs
